comments.author: CHINICE
comments.body_html: Hello, this is a great mod. I was wondering if it’s possible to tie mileage rewards to categories, and make the rewards given by each trader related to the trader’s own attributes—for example, a doctor would only give medical items. Also, is there any way to obtain permanent mail similar to the one in the official version? That might even allow for something like a “mail card” mechanic in Fika, giving players more fun. These are just my thoughts—please forgive me if I’ve overstepped, haha. Really, it’s a great mod that gives me the motivation to keep playing.

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html:
Thanks, glad it keeps you motivated!

You can already do what you want. Each milestone has its own sender (trader ID) and reward_pool in the config, so you can tie Therapist milestones to meds only, Mechanic to weapons, etc. It’s all in the Configuration tab on the mod page. If you put together a themed config, feel free to share it as an addon (see the Addons tab)!

About permanent mail, could you clarify what you mean? The mails with item rewards expire after a set time (that’s an SPT/EFT limitation), but the messages themselves stay in your dialogue history. I’m not sure I follow the “mail card” idea for Fika either (I’m not using Fika), happy to hear more about what you have in mind!

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html: Rewards are randomly picked from entire item categories (meds, ammo, gear, etc.) from the database, so you can occasionally get strange items, that’s part of the RNG fun!

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html: That’s expected for a high-level player! The default thresholds are tuned for a “beginner rat” playstyle, so if you’re dropping dozens of kills per raid at Lvl 43, you’ll naturally hit multiple milestones every run. You can increase threshold_multiplier in mod_config.jsonc to space out rewards (e.g. 2.0 = double all thresholds), or tweak individual “every” values to match your playstyle. Feel free to share a “chad” addon config if you do!
